list.title: Subsidiaries
list.subtitle: Live data from the TonyAI API
list.subtitleUser: Live data from the TonyAI API · {name} ({role})
list.empty: No subsidiaries accessible to your account.
list.deleteBody: This permanently removes the subsidiary and is recorded in the audit log. A subsidiary that still holds activity records, locations, targets or closed reporting periods cannot be removed — deleting it would destroy them, and their evidence with them.

create.title: Add subsidiary
create.locationsHint: A subsidiary's locations are its reporting borders — add at least one. You can add more later on its page.
create.draftCap: A subsidiary can be created with at most {max} locations. Add the rest from its page.
create.locationRequired: Add at least one operational location

detail.notFoundBody: This subsidiary does not exist, or you no longer have access to it.
detail.readOnly: You can view this subsidiary, but only a super_admin can change it.
detail.loadFailed: This subsidiary could not be loaded.
detail.contactHint: Who to reach about this subsidiary's data — the person who prepares or coordinates the inventory, not whoever signs it off. Visible to everyone in this organisation, including an external consultant, and kept in the audit trail, so prefer a role mailbox over a personal number.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this subsidiary.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now.

geographyChange.title: Change geography from {from} to {to}?
geographyChange.body: Warning: Changing the geography will change the configured factor basis for geography dependent calculations. This may require recalculation of affected Scope 2 records for selected reporting periods. Do you want to continue?
geographyChange.subsidiaryNote: Records already committed keep the emission factor they were calculated with — those figures do not change. The new geography applies to records created from now on.
geographyChange.locationNote: Records already committed at this location keep the emission factor they were calculated with — those figures do not change. The new geography applies to records created here from now on, and to any draft or sent-back record the next time it is saved.

dependents.title: What depends on this subsidiary
dependents.deletableOne: This subsidiary can be deleted from the register. Its {count} location would go with it, each recorded in the audit log.
dependents.deletableMany: This subsidiary can be deleted from the register. Its {count} locations would go with it, each recorded in the audit log.
dependents.deletableNothing: Nothing depends on this subsidiary, so it can be deleted from the register.

blockers.terminalRecords: {count} approved, locked or voided activity record(s) belong to this subsidiary, and deleting it would permanently destroy them along with their evidence. Those records cannot be deleted at any point, so a subsidiary that has reported data stays. Set its status to "inactive" to retire it instead.
blockers.frozenBoundaryVersions: This subsidiary is declared in {count} confirmed or captured inventory boundary version(s), which record the inventory a report was issued from and never change, so a subsidiary declared in one stays. Set its status to "inactive" to retire it instead.
blockers.locationsHoldingForeignRecords: {count} location(s) holding a record that belongs to another subsidiary
blockers.openBoundaryVersions: {count} open inventory boundary version(s) declaring it

locations.empty: No locations recorded for this subsidiary yet.
locations.name: Name *
locations.geographyHint: Drives the emission factor for records at this location.
locations.readOnly: Only a super_admin can add or modify locations.
locations.deleteBody: This permanently removes the location and is recorded in the audit log. A location that activity records are attached to cannot be removed — those records would end up showing a different geography than the one they were calculated with.

locks.title: Period locks
locks.description: {name} — a locked period rejects any new, edited or submitted records (FR §4.2).
locks.empty: No locked periods — all reporting periods are open.
locks.hint: Committed records in the period flip to locked; unlocking reverts them to approved. Both actions are audited.
locks.readOnly: Only a super_admin can lock or unlock reporting periods.
locks.locked: Locked {period} {year} — records in this period are now frozen
